invariants.rationale: If 'drawable' is non-null, 'scaling' must also be non-null since scaling.apply() is called unconditionally after the drawable null check.
Width returned by getWidth() should be non-negative if drawable is present, since negative UI dimensions are uncommon.
Height returned by getHeight() should be non-negative if drawable is present, since negative UI dimensions are uncommon.
If 'scaling' is null, the method will throw a NullPointerException when drawable is not null. This invariant expresses the contrapositive of 'drawable == null || scaling != null'.
